ddl.ai_provider_configs:
CREATE TABLE `ai_provider_configs` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `provider_name` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Identificador do provedor (google_gemini, anthropic, openai)',
  `model_alias` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Alias do modelo utilizado',
  `api_key_encrypted` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Chave de API cifrada. NUNCA armazene chaves em texto puro!',
  `key_vault_reference` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Apelido ou caminho no Key Vault / Secrets Manager',
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT 'Flag de ativação',
  `rate_limit_rpm` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '60' COMMENT 'Limite de requisições por minuto',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_provider_model` (`provider_name`,`model_alias`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Configurações de modelos e credenciais criptografadas de provedores de IA'
ddl.assistant_actions:
CREATE TABLE `assistant_actions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `conversation_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Conversa originária da ação',
  `message_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Mensagem de gatilho',
  `action_type` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tipo de ação (ex: propose_document_change, query_github, generate_task)',
  `target_resource_type` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Entidade alvo (document, technical_context, prompt, task, problem)',
  `target_resource_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Identificador numérico do recurso alvo',
  `execution_status` enum('proposed','executed','rejected','failed') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed' COMMENT 'Status de execução da ação',
  `parameters_json` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Parâmetros enviados à ação',
  `result_json` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Resultado ou retorno gerado pela ação',
  `executed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Momento em que foi efetivada',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_aa_conversation` (`conversation_id`),
  KEY `idx_aa_target` (`target_resource_type`,`target_resource_id`),
  KEY `idx_aa_status` (`execution_status`),
  KEY `fk_aa_message` (`message_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_aa_conversation` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `assistant_conversations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_aa_message` FOREIGN KEY (`message_id`) REFERENCES `assistant_messages` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Auditoria de ações autônomas ou assistidas propostas pelo assistente'
ddl.assistant_conversations:
CREATE TABLE `assistant_conversations` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário proprietário da conversa',
  `project_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto contextualizado (ou NULL se conversa geral)',
  `title` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Título descritivo da conversa',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_ac_user` (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_ac_project` (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ac_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ac_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Sessões de conversa mantidas com o assistente técnico'
ddl.assistant_messages:
CREATE TABLE `assistant_messages` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `conversation_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Conversa associada',
  `sender_type` enum('user','assistant','system') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Origem da mensagem',
  `message_content` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Conteúdo textual da mensagem',
  `tokens_used` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Quantidade de tokens processados',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_am_conv` (`conversation_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_am_conversation` FOREIGN KEY (`conversation_id`) REFERENCES `assistant_conversations` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico de mensagens trocadas na conversa com o assistente'
ddl.audit_logs:
CREATE TABLE `audit_logs` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário autor da ação (NULL para ações de sistema/serviço)',
  `project_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto contextual (se aplicável)',
  `action` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome canônico da ação (ex: membership.revoked, document.approved)',
  `resource_type` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tipo da entidade afetada (users, projects, documents, solutions)',
  `resource_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'ID da entidade afetada',
  `old_values_json` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Valores anteriores (excluindo senhas e tokens)',
  `new_values_json` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Novos valores (excluindo senhas e tokens)',
  `ip_address` varchar(45) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Endereço IP (IPv4 ou IPv6)',
  `user_agent` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'User-Agent do cliente solicitante',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT 'Momento do evento',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_audit_resource` (`resource_type`,`resource_id`),
  KEY `idx_audit_user` (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_audit_project` (`project_id`),
  KEY `idx_audit_created` (`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_audit_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_audit_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Registro imutável de auditoria de operações críticas'
ddl.categories:
CREATE TABLE `categories` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto ao qual pertence (NULL indica categoria global)',
  `name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome da categoria',
  `slug` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Slug identificador',
  `description` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Descrição sucinta da finalidade',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_categories_project_slug` (`project_id`,`slug`),
  KEY `idx_categories_project` (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_categories_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Categorias para organização de documentos e prompts'
ddl.document_change_request_decisions:
CREATE TABLE `document_change_request_decisions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `change_request_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Solicitação de alteração decidida',
  `decided_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Administrador/Revisor que tomou a decisão',
  `decision` enum('approved','rejected') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Resultado da decisão',
  `comments` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Justificativa da aprovação ou rejeição',
  `decided_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_dcrd_cr` (`change_request_id`),
  KEY `idx_dcrd_decider` (`decided_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_dcrd_decider` FOREIGN KEY (`decided_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_dcrd_request` FOREIGN KEY (`change_request_id`) REFERENCES `document_change_requests` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico de decisões para solicitações de documentos'
ddl.document_change_requests:
CREATE TABLE `document_change_requests` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Documento afetado',
  `proposed_version_number` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Número da nova versão proposta',
  `proposed_title` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Título proposto',
  `proposed_content` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Conteúdo Markdown proposto',
  `reason` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Justificativa da alteração',
  `status` enum('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'Estado da solicitação',
  `author_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Autor da proposta',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_dcr_pending_document` (((case when (`status` = _utf8mb4'pending') then `document_id` else NULL end))),
  KEY `idx_dcr_document_status` (`document_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_dcr_author` (`author_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_dcr_author` FOREIGN KEY (`author_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_dcr_document` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Solicitações de alteração em documentos'
ddl.document_drafts:
CREATE TABLE `document_drafts` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `content_markdown` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_document_drafts_document` (`document_id`),
  KEY `fk_document_drafts_user` (`updated_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_document_drafts_document` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_document_drafts_user` FOREIGN KEY (`updated_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.document_tags:
CREATE TABLE `document_tags` (
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Documento associado',
  `tag_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tag vinculada',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`document_id`,`tag_id`),
  KEY `idx_doc_tags_tag` (`tag_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_doc_tags_document` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_doc_tags_tag` FOREIGN KEY (`tag_id`) REFERENCES `tags` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Tabela pivô entre documentos e tags'
ddl.document_versions:
CREATE TABLE `document_versions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Documento pai da versão',
  `version_number` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Número sequencial da versão (1, 2, 3...)',
  `title` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Título registrado nesta versão',
  `content_markdown` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Conteúdo completo do documento em Markdown',
  `changelog` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Resumo das alterações em relação à versão anterior',
  `created_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Autor da versão',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_doc_versions_number` (`document_id`,`version_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_doc_versions_pair` (`id`,`document_id`) COMMENT 'Necessário para FK composta de integridade de versão em documents',
  KEY `idx_doc_versions_author` (`created_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_doc_versions_author` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_doc_versions_doc` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `documents` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico imutável de versões de documentos'
ddl.documents:
CREATE TABLE `documents` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto ao qual o documento pertence',
  `category_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Categoria do documento',
  `title` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Título do documento',
  `slug` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Slug do documento no projeto',
  `section_key` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `current_version_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Versão oficial atual do documento',
  `is_archived` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Flag de arquivamento',
  `archived_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Momento do arquivamento',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_documents_project_slug` (`project_id`,`slug`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_documents_project_section` (`project_id`,`section_key`),
  KEY `idx_documents_category` (`category_id`),
  KEY `idx_documents_current_version` (`current_version_id`),
  KEY `idx_documents_archived` (`is_archived`),
  KEY `fk_documents_current_version_pair` (`current_version_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_documents_category` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `categories` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_documents_current_version_pair` FOREIGN KEY (`current_version_id`, `id`) REFERENCES `document_versions` (`id`, `document_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_documents_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Documentos centrais do projeto'
ddl.github_connections:
CREATE TABLE `github_connections` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto vinculado',
  `repository_owner` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Organização ou usuário dono do repo',
  `repository_name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome do repositório',
  `installation_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'ID da GitHub App Installation',
  `access_token_encrypted` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Token cifrado com chave KMS/AES-256-GCM. NUNCA armazene em texto puro!',
  `token_key_id` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Identificador da chave no KMS/Vault para decriptação',
  `token_expires_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Expiração do access token da GitHub App',
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT 'Flag de conexão ativa',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_gh_conn_project` (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_gh_conn_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Metadados de integração GitHub com tokens estritamente criptografados'
ddl.github_query_logs:
CREATE TABLE `github_query_logs` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto que disparou a consulta',
  `endpoint` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Endpoint da API do GitHub consultado (ex: /repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits)',
  `http_method` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GET' COMMENT 'Verbo HTTP (restrito a leituras)',
  `request_summary` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Sumário da requisição (estritamente sem tokens ou segredos)',
  `http_status` smallint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Código HTTP retornado pelo GitHub',
  `response_time_ms` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Latência da consulta em milissegundos',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_gql_project` (`project_id`),
  KEY `idx_gql_created` (`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_gql_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Auditoria técnica de consultas à API do GitHub (somente leitura)'
ddl.github_webhook_events:
CREATE TABLE `github_webhook_events` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `delivery_id` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Identificador único global do evento fornecido pelo GitHub (X-GitHub-Delivery)',
  `event_type` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tipo do evento (push, pull_request, issues, etc.)',
  `repository_full_name` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'owner/repo associado',
  `payload_hash` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Hash SHA-256 do payload recebido para integridade',
  `action` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Ação do evento (opened, synchronize, closed)',
  `processed_status` enum('received','processed','ignored','failed') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received' COMMENT 'Estado do processamento',
  `error_message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Mensagem de erro em caso de falha',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_gh_delivery_id` (`delivery_id`) COMMENT 'Garante estrita deduplicação de webhooks do GitHub',
  KEY `idx_gh_events_repo_type` (`repository_full_name`,`event_type`),
  KEY `idx_gh_events_status` (`processed_status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Fila e deduplicação de webhooks recebidos do GitHub'
ddl.migrations:
CREATE TABLE `migrations` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `migration` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `batch` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.problem_diagnoses:
CREATE TABLE `problem_diagnoses` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `problem_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Problema analisado',
  `author_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Especialista que elaborou o diagnóstico',
  `root_cause` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Causa raiz identificada',
  `reproduction_steps` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Passos de reprodução do problema',
  `proposed_action` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Ação de mitigação sugerida',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_diagnoses_problem` (`problem_id`),
  KEY `idx_diagnoses_author` (`author_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_diagnoses_author` FOREIGN KEY (`author_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_diagnoses_problem` FOREIGN KEY (`problem_id`) REFERENCES `problems` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Diagnósticos técnicos de causas-raízes'
ddl.problem_event_histories:
CREATE TABLE `problem_event_histories` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `problem_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Problema auditado',

  `notes` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Notas explicativas do evento',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  CONSTRAINT `fk_peh_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Linha do tempo de ocorrências do problema'
ddl.problems:
CREATE TABLE `problems` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto onde o problema ocorre',
  `title` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Título descritivo do problema',
  `description` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Descrição aprofundada dos sintomas e impacto',
  `severity` enum('low','medium','high','critical') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium' COMMENT 'Gravidade do problema',
  `status` enum('open','diagnosed','resolved','closed') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' COMMENT 'Estado do problema',
  `reporter_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário que reportou o problema',
  `is_archived` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Flag de arquivamento',
  `archived_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Momento do arquivamento',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_problems_proj_status` (`project_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_problems_reporter` (`reporter_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_problems_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_problems_reporter` FOREIGN KEY (`reporter_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Problemas técnicos catalogados na base de conhecimento'
ddl.project_environments:
CREATE TABLE `project_environments` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto correspondente',
  `name` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome identificador do ambiente (ex: local, staging, production)',
  `env_type` enum('development','staging','production','testing') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tipo do ambiente',
  `base_url` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'URL base ou hostname',
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT 'Flag indicativa de ambiente ativo',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_project_env_name` (`project_id`,`name`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_proj_env_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Configurações de ambientes de deploy e execução'
ddl.project_memberships:
CREATE TABLE `project_memberships` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto ao qual o membro foi associado',
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário membro',
  `role_in_project` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'contributor' COMMENT 'Papel contextual no projeto (owner, lead, contributor, reviewer)',
  `status` enum('active','revoked') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' COMMENT 'Estado da associação',
  `granted_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT 'Data/hora da concessão do acesso',
  `granted_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário que concedeu o acesso',
  `revoked_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Data/hora da revogação do acesso',
  `revoked_by_user_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário que revogou o acesso',
  `active_user_project_key` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS (if((`status` = _utf8mb4'active'),concat(`project_id`,_utf8mb4':',`user_id`),NULL)) VIRTUAL COMMENT 'Chave virtual para garantir unicidade apenas de membros ativos',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_active_membership` (`active_user_project_key`),
  KEY `idx_memberships_proj_user` (`project_id`,`user_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_memberships_user` (`user_id`),
  KEY `fk_memberships_granted_by` (`granted_by_user_id`),
  KEY `fk_memberships_revoked_by` (`revoked_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_memberships_granted_by` FOREIGN KEY (`granted_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_memberships_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_memberships_revoked_by` FOREIGN KEY (`revoked_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_memberships_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Membros e permissões por projeto com histórico de revogações'
ddl.project_technologies:
CREATE TABLE `project_technologies` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto que utiliza a tecnologia',
  `name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome da tecnologia ou biblioteca',
  `version_specified` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Versão declarada ou utilizada',
  `category` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Categoria técnica (ex: language, framework, database, cache)',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_project_tech` (`project_id`,`name`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_proj_tech_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Matriz tecnológica associada a cada projeto'
ddl.projects:
CREATE TABLE `projects` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome do projeto',
  `slug` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Slug único do projeto na URL',
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Visão geral e objetivos do projeto',
  `repository_url` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'URL do repositório remoto Git',
  `status` enum('active','archived','paused') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' COMMENT 'Status do ciclo de vida do projeto',
  `owner_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário proprietário/criador do projeto',
  `is_archived` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Flag de arquivamento lógico',
  `archived_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Momento do arquivamento',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_projects_slug` (`slug`),
  KEY `idx_projects_owner` (`owner_user_id`),
  KEY `idx_projects_status` (`status`,`is_archived`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_projects_owner` FOREIGN KEY (`owner_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Projetos gerenciados na plataforma'
ddl.prompt_change_request_decisions:
CREATE TABLE `prompt_change_request_decisions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `change_request_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `decided_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `decision` enum('approved','rejected') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `comments` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `decided_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_pcrd_cr` (`change_request_id`),
  KEY `idx_pcrd_decider` (`decided_by_user_id`),

  CONSTRAINT `fk_pcrd_request` FOREIGN KEY (`change_request_id`) REFERENCES `prompt_change_requests` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico de decisões para solicitações de prompts'
ddl.prompt_change_requests:
CREATE TABLE `prompt_change_requests` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `prompt_template_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Prompt afetado',
  `proposed_version_number` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Número da nova versão proposta',
  `proposed_system_prompt` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `proposed_user_prompt_template` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `proposed_model_parameters_json` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `author_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_pcr_template_status` (`prompt_template_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_pcr_author` (`author_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_pcr_author` FOREIGN KEY (`author_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_pcr_template` FOREIGN KEY (`prompt_template_id`) REFERENCES `prompt_templates` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Solicitações de alteração em prompts'
ddl.prompt_favorites:
CREATE TABLE `prompt_favorites` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário que favoritou',
  `prompt_template_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Prompt favoritado',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_user_prompt_fav` (`user_id`,`prompt_template_id`),
  KEY `idx_fav_prompt` (`prompt_template_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_fav_prompt` FOREIGN KEY (`prompt_template_id`) REFERENCES `prompt_templates` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_fav_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Lista de favoritos de prompts por usuário'
ddl.prompt_templates:
CREATE TABLE `prompt_templates` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto ao qual pertence (NULL indica prompt global)',
  `category_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Categoria de prompt (tabela compartilhada categories)',
  `name` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome de exibição do prompt',
  `slug` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Slug identificador',
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Finalidade de uso do prompt',
  `current_version_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Versão oficial ativa',
  `is_archived` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Flag de arquivamento',
  `archived_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Momento do arquivamento',
  `created_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Criador inicial do template',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_prompt_proj_slug` (`project_id`,`slug`),
  KEY `idx_prompts_category` (`category_id`),
  KEY `idx_prompts_current_ver` (`current_version_id`),
  KEY `idx_prompts_author` (`created_by_user_id`),
  KEY `fk_prompts_current_version_pair` (`current_version_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_prompts_category` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `categories` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_prompts_creator` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_prompts_current_version_pair` FOREIGN KEY (`current_version_id`, `id`) REFERENCES `prompt_versions` (`id`, `prompt_template_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_prompts_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Biblioteca central de prompts'
ddl.prompt_variables:
CREATE TABLE `prompt_variables` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `prompt_template_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Template pai da variável',
  `prompt_version_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Versão específica a que se aplica (ou NULL para todas as versões)',
  `variable_name` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome do placeholder (ex: code_snippet, user_goal)',
  `default_value` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Valor padrão opcional',
  `is_required` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT 'Flag de obrigatoriedade',
  `description` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Instrução sobre o preenchimento da variável',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_pv_var_name` (`prompt_template_id`,`prompt_version_id`,`variable_name`),
  KEY `idx_pv_ver` (`prompt_version_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_pv_var_template` FOREIGN KEY (`prompt_template_id`) REFERENCES `prompt_templates` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_pv_var_version` FOREIGN KEY (`prompt_version_id`) REFERENCES `prompt_versions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Variáveis dinâmicas para interpolação de prompts'
ddl.prompt_versions:
CREATE TABLE `prompt_versions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `prompt_template_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Template do prompt',
  `version_number` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Número sequencial da versão',
  `system_prompt` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Instruções do sistema (system instructions)',
  `user_prompt_template` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Template da mensagem do usuário com {{variaveis}}',
  `model_parameters_json` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Parâmetros recomendados (temperature, top_p, max_tokens)',
  `changelog` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Resumo das alterações',
  `created_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Autor da versão',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_pv_versions_number` (`prompt_template_id`,`version_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_pv_versions_pair` (`id`,`prompt_template_id`) COMMENT 'Necessário para FK composta de integridade de versão',
  KEY `idx_pv_author` (`created_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_pv_author` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_pv_template` FOREIGN KEY (`prompt_template_id`) REFERENCES `prompt_templates` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico imutável de versões de prompts'
ddl.roles:
CREATE TABLE `roles` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome legível do papel (ex: Administrator, Programmer)',
  `slug` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Identificador de sistema do papel',
  `description` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Descrição das responsabilidades do papel',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_roles_name` (`name`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_roles_slug` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Papéis predefinidos da plataforma SPACE.dev'
ddl.solution_change_request_decisions:
CREATE TABLE `solution_change_request_decisions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `change_request_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `decided_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `decision` enum('approved','rejected') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `comments` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `decided_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_scrd_cr` (`change_request_id`),

  CONSTRAINT `fk_scrd_request` FOREIGN KEY (`change_request_id`) REFERENCES `solution_change_requests` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico de decisões para solicitações de soluções'
ddl.solution_change_requests:
CREATE TABLE `solution_change_requests` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Solução afetada',
  `proposed_version_number` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Número da nova versão proposta',
  `proposed_steps_markdown` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `proposed_code_snippet` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `proposed_rollback_plan` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,

  `status` enum('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `author_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_scr_solution_status` (`solution_id`,`status`),

  CONSTRAINT `fk_scr_author` FOREIGN KEY (`author_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_scr_solution` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_id`) REFERENCES `solutions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Solicitações de alteração para soluções'
ddl.solution_validations:
CREATE TABLE `solution_validations` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Solução validada',
  `solution_version_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Versão pontual testada',

  CONSTRAINT `fk_sol_val_solution` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_id`) REFERENCES `solutions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_sol_val_validator` FOREIGN KEY (`validated_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_sol_val_version` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_version_id`) REFERENCES `solution_versions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico de testes e validações práticas de soluções'
ddl.solution_versions:
CREATE TABLE `solution_versions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `solution_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Solução pai',
  `version_number` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Número da versão',

  `rollback_plan` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Plano de reversão em caso de insucesso',
  `changelog` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Motivo e alterações da nova versão',

  CONSTRAINT `fk_sol_ver_author` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_sol_ver_solution` FOREIGN KEY (`solution_id`) REFERENCES `solutions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Versões históricas com passos e plano de reversão de soluções'
ddl.solutions:
CREATE TABLE `solutions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `title` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Título sintetizado da solução',
  `current_version_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Versão oficial atual da solução',

  `author_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Autor da solução',
  `is_archived` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `archived_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_solutions_problem` (`problem_id`),
  KEY `idx_solutions_current_ver` (`current_version_id`),
  KEY `idx_solutions_author` (`author_user_id`),
  KEY `fk_solutions_current_version_pair` (`current_version_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_solutions_author` FOREIGN KEY (`author_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_solutions_current_version_pair` FOREIGN KEY (`current_version_id`, `id`) REFERENCES `solution_versions` (`id`, `solution_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_solutions_problem` FOREIGN KEY (`problem_id`) REFERENCES `problems` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Soluções técnicas vinculadas a problemas'
ddl.tags:
CREATE TABLE `tags` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto ao qual pertence (NULL indica tag global)',
  `name` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome da tag',
  `slug` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Slug identificador da tag',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_tags_project_slug` (`project_id`,`slug`),
  KEY `idx_tags_project` (`project_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tags_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Etiquetas (tags) para categorização transversal'
ddl.task_comments:
CREATE TABLE `task_comments` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `task_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tarefa comentada',
  `user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Autor do comentário',
  `comment_text` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Texto do comentário',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_tc_task` (`task_id`),
  KEY `idx_tc_user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tc_author` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tc_task` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Comentários e discussões em tarefas'
ddl.task_relations:
CREATE TABLE `task_relations` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `source_task_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tarefa de origem',
  `target_task_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tarefa de destino',
  `relation_type` enum('blocks','blocked_by','relates_to','duplicates') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tipo do vínculo',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_task_relation` (`source_task_id`,`target_task_id`,`relation_type`),
  KEY `idx_tr_target` (`target_task_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tr_source` FOREIGN KEY (`source_task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tr_target` FOREIGN KEY (`target_task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Dependências e correlações entre tarefas (sem autorrelacionamento)'
ddl.task_status_histories:
CREATE TABLE `task_status_histories` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `task_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Tarefa auditada',
  `changed_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário que alterou o status',
  `old_status` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Status anterior',
  `new_status` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Novo status',
  `reason` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Motivo opcional da transição',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_tsh_task` (`task_id`),
  KEY `idx_tsh_user` (`changed_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tsh_task` FOREIGN KEY (`task_id`) REFERENCES `tasks` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tsh_user` FOREIGN KEY (`changed_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico de transições de status de tarefas'
ddl.tasks:
CREATE TABLE `tasks` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto onde a tarefa está alocada',
  `title` varchar(200) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Título claro da tarefa',
  `description` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Instruções e escopo detalhado da tarefa',
  `task_type` enum('feature','bug','refactor','documentation','chore') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'feature' COMMENT 'Tipo da tarefa',
  `priority` enum('low','medium','high','urgent') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium' COMMENT 'Prioridade de entrega',
  `status` enum('todo','in_progress','review','done','archived') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo' COMMENT 'Status de fluxo',
  `assigned_user_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Desenvolvedor responsável atribuído',
  `reporter_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Criador/autor da tarefa',
  `is_archived` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Flag de arquivamento',
  `archived_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Momento do arquivamento',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `start_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `due_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `completed_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_tasks_project_status` (`project_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_tasks_assigned` (`assigned_user_id`),
  KEY `idx_tasks_reporter` (`reporter_user_id`),
  KEY `tasks_due_date_index` (`due_date`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tasks_assigned` FOREIGN KEY (`assigned_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tasks_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tasks_reporter` FOREIGN KEY (`reporter_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Quadro de tarefas do projeto'
ddl.technical_context_change_request_decisio:
CREATE TABLE `technical_context_change_request_decisions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `change_request_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Solicitação de contexto técnico',
  `decided_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário decisor',
  `decision` enum('approved','rejected') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `comments` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `decided_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_tccrd_cr` (`change_request_id`),
  KEY `idx_tccrd_decider` (`decided_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tccrd_decider` FOREIGN KEY (`decided_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tccrd_request` FOREIGN KEY (`change_request_id`) REFERENCES `technical_context_change_requests` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico de decisões para contextos técnicos'
ddl.technical_context_change_requests:
CREATE TABLE `technical_context_change_requests` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `technical_context_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Contexto técnico afetado',
  `proposed_version_number` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Número da versão proposta',
  `proposed_architecture_summary` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Resumo arquitetural proposto',
  `proposed_tech_stack_json` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Stack técnica proposta',
  `proposed_conventions_markdown` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Convenções propostas',
  `reason` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Motivação da alteração',
  `status` enum('pending','approved','rejected','cancelled') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `author_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Autor da proposta',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_tccr_pending_context` (((case when (`status` = _utf8mb4'pending') then `technical_context_id` else NULL end))),
  KEY `idx_tccr_context_status` (`technical_context_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_tccr_author` (`author_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tccr_author` FOREIGN KEY (`author_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tccr_context` FOREIGN KEY (`technical_context_id`) REFERENCES `technical_contexts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Solicitações de alteração em contextos técnicos'
ddl.technical_context_drafts:
CREATE TABLE `technical_context_drafts` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `technical_context_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `architecture_summary` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `tech_stack_json` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `conventions_markdown` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `updated_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_technical_context_drafts_context` (`technical_context_id`),
  KEY `fk_technical_context_drafts_user` (`updated_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_technical_context_drafts_context` FOREIGN KEY (`technical_context_id`) REFERENCES `technical_contexts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_technical_context_drafts_user` FOREIGN KEY (`updated_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
ddl.technical_context_versions:
CREATE TABLE `technical_context_versions` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `technical_context_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Contexto técnico pai',
  `version_number` int unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Número da versão',
  `architecture_summary` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Visão geral da arquitetura técnica',
  `tech_stack_json` json DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Estrutura detalhada da stack técnica',
  `conventions_markdown` mediumtext COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Convenções de código e padrões adotados',
  `changelog` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Motivo e alterações da versão',
  `created_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Usuário que elaborou a versão',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_tc_versions_number` (`technical_context_id`,`version_number`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_tc_versions_pair` (`id`,`technical_context_id`) COMMENT 'Necessário para FK composta de integridade de versão',
  KEY `idx_tc_versions_author` (`created_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tc_versions_author` FOREIGN KEY (`created_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tc_versions_ctx` FOREIGN KEY (`technical_context_id`) REFERENCES `technical_contexts` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Histórico de versões de contextos técnicos'
ddl.technical_contexts:
CREATE TABLE `technical_contexts` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `project_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Projeto detentor do contexto técnico',
  `title` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Título do contexto técnico',
  `slug` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Slug do contexto',
  `section_key` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Finalidade do contexto arquitetural',
  `current_version_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Versão oficial ativa',
  `is_archived` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT 'Flag de arquivamento',
  `archived_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Data do arquivamento',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_tech_ctx_proj_slug` (`project_id`,`slug`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_tech_ctx_project_section` (`project_id`,`section_key`),
  KEY `idx_tech_ctx_current_ver` (`current_version_id`),
  KEY `fk_tech_ctx_current_version_pair` (`current_version_id`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tech_ctx_current_version_pair` FOREIGN KEY (`current_version_id`, `id`) REFERENCES `technical_context_versions` (`id`, `technical_context_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tech_ctx_project` FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Contextos de arquitetura e tecnologia de projetos'
ddl.users:
CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `role_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Papel global padrão do usuário',
  `name` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Nome completo do usuário',
  `email` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'E-mail para autenticação e notificações',
  `password_hash` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Hash da senha (Argon2id ou Bcrypt)',
  `status` enum('active','inactive','suspended') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' COMMENT 'Estado da conta do usuário',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `remember_token` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_users_email` (`email`),
  KEY `idx_users_role` (`role_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_users_role` FOREIGN KEY (`role_id`) REFERENCES `roles` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Contas de usuários do SPACE.dev'
